notes: Own domain (jamescoffeeco.com) has no priced menu page - only Shopify retail catalog (correctly screened out) and a Square/Weebly instore.jamescoffeeco.com ordering site that is client-rendered with no embedded JSON. Filed from DoorDash white-label order.online RSC payload, address confirmed as 4379 30th Street matching the work list. 28 items across 7 categories (Coffee & Cold Brew 2, Seasonal Drinks 1, Espresso 6, Specialty Espresso 7, Not-Coffee Drinks 3, Tea & Sodas 5, Pastries 4) matches the page's own MenuBookCategory counts exactly - not truncated. Deduped against the Most Ordered carousel by name. Cent endings are mostly .00/.25/.50/.75 (typical coffee-shop pricing), no consistent divisor found on a markup sweep. A Grubhub search snippet (different owner) showed several items 4-9% higher (Latte $6.50 vs $6.25 here, Espresso $4.50 vs $4.25) but Grubhub's own page returned no client data on fetch so it could not be independently verified either way - not used as a cross-check.

name: Shozen BBQ
notes: Own site (shozenmanpo.com) is SG-Captcha bot-walled on every page tried, same as Athens Market Taverna. Grubhub page returns an empty client-rendered shell (platform-wide limitation, confirmed again here). Filed from Uber Eats catalogSectionsMap/catalogItems JSON (no schema.org hasMenu present on this page), address 9906 Mira Mesa Blvd confirmed in page content matching the work-list address. 31 raw item blocks found matching the uuid+title pattern, 30 unique after removing one exact duplicate - matches the page's own 3 catalogSectionsMap sections (Appetizer, Korean Special, Korean B.B.Q special) with no truncation signal. A MapQuest listing mentions a $34 all-you-can-eat BBQ option coexisting with this itemized a-la-carte menu, so this is not a buffet-only situation. Grubhub and SinglePlatform search snippets show some items at different prices (e.g. Sweet & Sour Pork $35.92 vs $33.00 here, Bool go gi Special $24.95 on SinglePlatform vs Bool go gi $37.95 here likely a different/smaller portion) - not used as cross-check per tier-5 aggregator rule, Uber Eats filed as sole source.

name: Mexico Lindo Restaurant
notes: Own domain mexicolindoresturant.com (note the typo in the domain, matching the batch listing) is a marketing-only landing page with no priced menu, but links to a first-party Clover POS online-ordering site (mexicolindo.smartonlineorder.com) whose public WordPress REST API (wp-json/moo-clover/v1) was queried directly for all 17 categories and their items - this is the restaurant's live POS-synced menu data, not a third-party aggregator. 127 raw items returned across 17 categories; 4 dropped for zero/missing price (Aguas Frescas, Soda Bottle, Huraches, Vaso de Salsa - likely priced only via in-store modifiers not exposed here), leaving 123 priced dishes, all price_type FIXED, none out of stock. Address 169 S Juniper St, Escondido, CA 92025 confirmed on the site, in San Diego County. Prices range $0.75-$22.50, consistent with a full-service Mexican restaurant a-la-carte menu (breakfast items, burritos, tortas, seafood, tacos, sides) - no markup pattern since this is the operator's own ordering backend, not a delivery marketplace.
